scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The desk next to yours has been vacant since January.
scene.zh: 你旁邊那張桌子從一月就一直空著。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We really need an extra pair of hands.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I know. That's why I asked Ms. Reed to help us recruit someone.

scene.speaker: npc

scene.en: Do we need someone full time, or would part time be enough?

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: player

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll reject him. And here's Leo Martin's application.
scene.zh: 那我就不錄取他了。對了，這是 Leo Martin 的應徵資料。

passages.title: Application for the assistant position
lines: I am writing about the assistant position you are seeking to fill at Harbor Trading.
I studied business in college on a scholarship. While I was on campus, I did an internship at a small design company.

After graduation, I worked for two years as a salesperson at Bright Corner, a store that specializes in lighting. I became very knowledgeable about desk lamps, and I learned how to help all kinds of customers.
I am highly organized, and I possess the computer proficiency the job requires, although I am still learning some office software.
I am now seeking employment in an office, where I can work full time and broaden my experience. I would bring real enthusiasm to your team.
My resume is attached. I can start on April 1.
I would be happy to talk with you about the job at any time.

questions.en: What did Leo do for the last two years?
questions.zh: Leo 過去兩年在做什麼工作？
options: He worked at a design company.
He sold lamps in a store.

questions.zh: 他說自己哪方面還在學？
他最快什麼時候可以上班？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you read Leo Martin's cover letter? It came with his resume.
scene.zh: 你看了 Leo Martin 的求職信嗎？是跟履歷一起寄來的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: His cover letter is short, but it's really well written.
scene.zh: 他的求職信很短，但寫得真的很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Agreed. He was a salesperson at a lamp store for two years.
scene.zh: 同意。他在一家燈具店當了兩年店員。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The store specializes in lighting, so he's very knowledgeable about lamps.
scene.zh: 那家店專賣燈具，所以他對燈很懂。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: He studied business on a scholarship, too.
scene.zh: 他念商科，而且是拿獎學金念的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And you can really feel his enthusiasm. I'd like to meet him.
scene.zh: 而且看得出他真的很有熱情。我想見見他。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll ask Ms. Carter about an interview this week.
scene.zh: 我來問 Carter 小姐這週能不能面試他。

lines.en: You sold a lot of lamps at Bright Corner, Leo. Are you a strong salesperson?
lines.zh: Leo，你在 Bright Corner 賣了很多燈。你很會推銷嗎？

lines.en: I'm not an aggressive salesperson. I listen to the customer first.
lines.zh: 我不是很強勢的推銷員。我會先聽客人怎麼說。

lines.en: And why do you want to leave the store?
lines.zh: 那你為什麼想離開那家店？

lines.en: I want to learn office work. There aren't many prospects at a small store.
lines.zh: 我想學辦公室的工作。在小店裡沒什麼往上發展的機會。

lines.en: How are you with spreadsheets?
lines.zh: 那你試算表用得怎麼樣？

lines.en: Honestly, I'm a beginner with spreadsheets. But I learn fast.
lines.zh: 老實說，我的試算表還是新手程度。不過我學得很快。

lines.en: That's fine. We can teach you.
lines.zh: 沒關係，我們可以教你。

lines.en: Is it hard to leave your customers?
lines.zh: 要離開你的客人會很難嗎？

lines.en: A little. Some of them have come in for years, so I'm a bit reluctant.
lines.zh: 有一點。有些客人來了好幾年，所以我有點捨不得。

lines.en: Thank you, Leo. We'll call you by Friday.
lines.zh: 謝謝你，Leo。我們星期五前會打給你。

questions.en: Why does Leo want a new job?
options: He wants to learn office work.

questions.en: What is Leo a beginner at?
questions.zh: Leo 說自己哪方面是新手？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome, Leo. We're your interview panel today, just the two of us.
scene.zh: 歡迎，Leo。今天的面試小組就是我們兩個。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice to meet you both. Honestly, I'm a little nervous.
scene.zh: 很高興見到兩位。老實說，我有點緊張。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Don't be. This is pretty informal.
scene.zh: 別緊張，今天很輕鬆。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Why don't you start by telling us about yourself?
scene.zh: 要不要先跟我們介紹一下你自己？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. I studied business, and then I sold lamps for two years.
scene.zh: 好的。我念商科，之後賣了兩年的燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I have a curious personality. I like to know how things are made.
scene.zh: 我的個性很好奇，喜歡知道東西是怎麼做出來的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you tell us why you're interested in this job?
scene.zh: 可以跟我們說說你為什麼對這份工作有興趣嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm ambitious. I want to help make products, not just sell them.
scene.zh: 我有企圖心。我想幫忙做產品，不只是賣產品。

textFills.title: Reference check for Leo
lines: I called Leo's former manager today. She told me she ___ miss him a lot.
Customers called him the lamp ___ because he knew every lamp in the store.
She said he always showed a real willingness to learn.
She tried hard to retain him, but he wants to work in an office. ___
zh: 我今天打給 Leo 之前的主管了。她跟我說她會很想他。
客人都叫他「檯燈行家」，因為店裡每一盞燈他都很熟。
她說他一直都很願意學新東西。
她很努力想留住他，但他想在辦公室工作。所以我覺得他會是很棒的助理。

blanks.note: 間接引述：will 退成 would。
每一盞燈都很熟的人是行家：specialist。

options: So I think he'd be a great assistant for us.
So we should reject his application.
So he can't start until next year.
So she's going to give him more hours.
blanks.note: 前面都在說他的好話，最後的結論是他會是很好的助理。

prompt.en: When are you calling his former manager?
prompt.zh: 你什麼時候要打給他之前的主管？

responses.en: She was his manager for two years.

prompt.en: How did he treat customers at the store?
prompt.zh: 他在店裡對客人怎麼樣？

responses.en: He wants to learn office work.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, you called the lamp store. How did it go?
scene.zh: 所以你打給那家燈具店了。結果怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: His former manager said he was always on time.
scene.zh: 他之前的主管說他一向很準時。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. We need someone punctual.
scene.zh: 很好。我們需要準時的人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And how did they feel about him leaving?
scene.zh: 那他要離職，他們有什麼反應？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: She told me they really didn't want to lose him.
scene.zh: 她跟我說，他們真的很捨不得他走。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm not surprised. He sounds hardworking and capable.
scene.zh: 我不意外。聽起來他很認真，也很能幹。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: His only weak spot is his inexperience in an office.
scene.zh: 他唯一的弱點是沒有辦公室的經驗。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's fine. He's eager to learn, and that's what matters.
scene.zh: 沒關係。他很想學，這才是重點。

lines.en: Hi, it's Ms. Reed. I've put the panel's notes together.
lines.zh: 嗨，我是人資的 Reed。面試小組的筆記我整理好了。

lines.en: We scored the three applicants individually, with the same selection criteria.
lines.zh: 三位應徵者是用同一套甄選標準，一個一個打分數的。

lines.en: Leo and the referral from Dan's friend were almost equal.
lines.zh: Leo 和 Dan 的朋友推薦來的那位幾乎不相上下。

lines.en: But Leo had the highest score, mostly because he knows lamps and customers.
lines.zh: 不過 Leo 分數最高，主要是因為他懂燈，也懂客人。

lines.en: Lantern launches in May, so let's not wait.
lines.zh: Lantern 五月就要上市了，所以我們別再等了。

lines.en: Please call Leo tomorrow and make him a verbal offer.
lines.zh: 請你明天打給 Leo，先口頭錄取他。

lines.en: After he says yes, I'll send the offer letter and the personnel forms.
lines.zh: 他答應之後，我會寄錄取信和人事資料表給他。

lines.en: He'll be the first person we've added to our workforce this year.
lines.zh: 他會是公司今年第一個新增的員工。

lines.en: I'll also tell the placement agency that our recruitment is over.
lines.zh: 我也會通知人力仲介，這次招募結束了。

lines.en: And I'm conducting one last reference check this afternoon. Bye!
lines.zh: 還有，我今天下午會做最後一次推薦人查核。拜拜！

options: One by one, with the same criteria

questions.en: What does Ms. Reed ask you to do?
What will she tell the placement agency?
questions.zh: 她會跟人力仲介說什麼？

scene.en: Hi, thanks for calling back. Did you get my message?
scene.zh: 嗨，謝謝你回電。你有聽到我的留言嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We scored all three applicants the same way.
scene.zh: 三位應徵者我們都是用同樣的方式打分數。

scene.zh: 他答應之後，我再寄人事資料表給他。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 我們公司終於又要多一個人了。做得好！

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We'd like to offer you the assistant position.
scene.zh: 我們想錄取你擔任助理這個職位。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 不用有壓力，Leo。你不一定要今天回覆。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I don't need time. I'm happy to accept!
scene.zh: 我不用考慮，我很樂意接受！

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 商務休閒就好。三個月的試用期過了，你就是正式員工。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 你知道到目前為止有多少人應徵嗎？

scene.zh: 現在快四十個了。不過我最喜歡 Leo 的資料。

scene.en: His cover letter is short, but it's really well written.
scene.zh: 他的求職信很短，但寫得真的很好。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 對。不過他沒有設計的學歷。

scene.en: Experience matters more to me than a degree.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, I'm Leo Martin. Nice to meet you both.
scene.zh: 您好，我是 Leo Martin。很高興見到兩位。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome, Leo. Have a seat. This is pretty informal.
scene.zh: 歡迎，Leo。請坐。今天很輕鬆。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Why don't you start by telling us about yourself?
scene.zh: 要不要先跟我們介紹一下你自己？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. I've sold lamps at Bright Corner for two years.
scene.zh: 好的。我在 Bright Corner 賣了兩年的燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can I ask why the job is open now?
scene.zh: 可以問一下為什麼現在要找人嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We really need an extra pair of hands.
scene.zh: 我們真的需要多一個人手。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks, Leo. Could you wait outside for a few minutes?
scene.zh: 謝謝你，Leo。可以請你在外面等幾分鐘嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, you called his store this morning. What did they say?
scene.zh: 你今天早上打給他的店了吧。他們怎麼說？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: His former manager said he was always on time.
scene.zh: 他之前的主管說他一向很準時。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. He's energetic, and we're not overpaying him. I think he's the one.
scene.zh: 很好。他很有活力，薪水也不會給太多。我覺得就是他了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I agree Leo is the best fit for the team.
scene.zh: 我也覺得 Leo 是最適合我們團隊的人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then let's ask him back in.
scene.zh: 那我們請他回來吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Is everything okay?
scene.zh: 一切都還好嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We'd like to offer you the assistant position.
scene.zh: 我們想錄取你擔任助理這個職位。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Really? Yes! Thank you both so much!
scene.zh: 真的嗎？好！真的很謝謝兩位！
